zh: 西澳大学（The University of Western Australia，简称UWA）成立于1911年，位于澳大利亚西澳大利亚州珀斯市，是澳大利亚著名的公立研究型大学，也是澳洲八大名校联盟成员。学校在矿业工程、海洋科学、农业科学、医学、社会科学等领域享有盛誉，其学术研究水平位居澳大利亚前列。西澳大学以其优秀的教学质量和优美的校园环境，培养了大量各领域的杰出人才。
en: The University of Western Australia (UWA), founded in 1911, is a renowned public research university in Perth, Western Australia, and a member of the Group of Eight. It excels in mining engineering, marine science, agricultural science, medicine, social sciences, and more, with leading academic research in Australia. Known for its excellent teaching quality and beautiful campus, UWA has produced numerous talents across fields.

address.zh: 澳大利亚西澳大利亚州珀斯市克劳利
